name: Sticky Notice Bar
author: Stephen Moore

sections.description:
Sticky Notice Bar lets you add an attention-grabbing announcement banner to your site — perfect for promotions, alerts, or important messages.

Set custom text, colors, display dates, and a version number to re-show updated notices. Visitors can dismiss the bar and won’t see it again until you publish a new version.

Works great with any theme and adds no bloat. Just install, set your message, and go.

🔧 Features:

  • Custom notice text
  • Choose background and text colors
  • Set start and end dates for scheduled display
  • Dismissible by visitors
  • Show again by changing the version number
  • Lightweight and theme-compatible

Upgrade to Sticky Notice Bar Pro for more features:
– Top or bottom placement
– CTA button with custom link
– Display Pro-only messages or branding
– Page-specific visibility (coming soon)
– Recurring display schedules (coming soon)
– Icons, animations, and more
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sticky-notice-bar directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Sticky Notice Bar to configure your message.
sections.faq:
How do I hide the bar after a visitor sees it?

The bar is automatically hidden once dismissed and only returns when you update the version number.

Can I show it only on certain pages?

That feature is available in the Pro version.

Can I place the bar at the bottom instead of the top?

Yes, with Sticky Notice Bar Pro.

Will this work with any theme?

Yes. The bar is injected using standard WordPress hooks and works with most themes out of the box.

What are the “coming soon” Pro features?

Sticky Notice Bar Pro will soon support visibility on specific pages (e.g., only on homepage or shop) and recurring display logic (e.g., show every Monday).
